sections.name: File setup, SHIFTS
sections.title: Slice settings
sections.what: Sets how many slices the headline is cut into and how far each one shifts sideways. These numbers drive the text effect.
sections.why: The settings are at the top so the look can be tuned without changing the drawing code.
sections.watch_out: Keep the shift list the same length as the slice count.

sections.name: SlicedLine
sections.title: Sliced text helper
sections.what: Draws one line of text several times. Each copy is cut to a thin band, nudged sideways, and given a short delay, so the line appears to split as it animates in.
sections.why: Likely reason: a visual effect for the headline. The copies are hidden from screen readers, so the plain text is the one that gets read aloud.
sections.watch_out: The effect depends on CSS classes defined elsewhere. Without those classes, the copies will stack on top of the text.

sections.name: Contact
sections.title: Contact section
sections.what: Shows the heading with the sliced lines, then a list of links that reveal on scroll, then a footer with the name, year, tagline, and back-to-top link.
sections.why: Ends the home page with ways to reach the owner and a clear way back to the top.
sections.watch_out: The links open in a new tab with safety attributes. Keep those attributes when editing the list.

summary: The final contact section of the home page: a large headline with a sliced text effect, a list of outside links, and a footer with the name, year, and a back-to-top link.
purpose: Gives visitors a way to reach the owner and closes the page.
why: Likely reason: the text effect gives the page a memorable finish. The links come from the site data, so they are edited in one place.
how: Shows the headline with the sliced text effect. Lists each link from the site data, opening in a new tab. Renders a footer with the name, the current year, the tagline, and a back-to-top link.
inputs: The site data (name, tagline, links) and the current date when the page is built or rendered.
outputs: A section with a headline, a linked list, and a footer.
risks: The shift list must have the same number of values as the slice count. If not, some slices will move by an unexpected amount or not at all. The year is read when the page is rendered, and the site is likely built as a static page, so the year is fixed at build time.
debug: If the headline looks broken, compare the slice count with the length of the shift list. If a link is wrong, check the links list in the site data.
